name: create_csharp_semaphore_limiter
description: Implements a max-concurrency async task runner with SemaphoreSlim
prompts: Create Limiter.cs with namespace Throttling and a static class Limiter exposing: public static async Task<T[]> RunLimited<T>(IReadOnlyList<Func<Task<T>>> taskFactories, int maxConcurrency). It starts the factories so that AT MOST maxConcurrency tasks are in flight at once (SemaphoreSlim is the standard tool - remember to release in a finally), awaits them all, and returns their results in factory order. All factories must run even if some of them throw - collect the first exception and rethrow it AFTER every started task has settled. Do not create or modify Program.cs.
